intro: If Manali has been on your list, consider this your sign. Pine forests, snow peaks and the road to Lahaul, all within reach of a short holiday.

sections.heading: Why visit Manali
paragraphs: Manali (Himachal Pradesh) is known for its mountain, adventure and snow experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to June for pleasant weather, December to February for snow.

list: Old Manali cafés and the Hadimba Temple

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Check Rohtang Pass permits and road status a day before — they change with the weather.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Manali?
faq.a: March to June for pleasant weather, December to February for snow.
Overnight Volvo buses from Delhi are the most popular option; the nearest airport is Bhuntar near Kullu.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Manali?
faq.a: Popular choices: Old Manali for backpacker vibes; Mall Road for convenience; Vashisht for hot springs and views.
